{{Quote|Fighters incoming. Gold Two and Five on me for the trench. The rest of the squad, engage the TIEs. Hold them off.|Jon Vander gives orders to Lepira and the rest of Gold Squadron|<ref name="Sparks">{{StoryCite|story=Sparks (short story)|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref>}}
'''Lepira''' was a [[human]] who served as a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin]], the [[pilot]] was based in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] and attended a briefing on the weakness of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] there when the [[superweapon]] arrived to destroy the base. Lepira then flew a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] and [[Death|perished]] during the fighting.

==Biography==
===Gold Squadron pilot===
[[File:DeathStar_plans.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A room full of rebel pilots look at a screen showing the Death Star's thermal exhaust port. Jan Dodonna stands beside the screen.|Lepira attended a briefing in the Great Temple before the Battle of Yavin.]]
Lepira<ref name="Odyssey" /> was a [[human]] who served as a [[rebel pilot]] in the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ANH" /> The [[pilot]] flew as a member of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]],<ref name="Odyssey" /> a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]] [[squadron]] led by [[Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander]] as part of the [[Massassi Group]] based in the rebels' [[Great Temple]] headquarters on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] arrived in the [[Yavin system]] in order to destroy the rebel base. Lepira sat next to<ref name="ANH" /> pilot [[Elyhek Rue]]<ref name="Grounded">{{StoryCite|story=Grounded|book=From a Certain Point of View}}</ref> during a meeting in the temple, in which [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] briefed the assembled rebel pilots on a weakness in the [[Death Star]]'s [[thermal exhaust port]] that they would need to use to destroy it. Once the briefing was complete, Lepira and the rest of Gold Squadron took off alongside the [[X-wing starfighter]]s of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]]<ref name="ANH" /> and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]].<ref name="Odyssey" />

===Battle of Yavin===
[[File:Battle_of_Yavin.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=A group of rebel X-wing and Y-wing starfighters in space preparing to attack the Death Star with Yavin 4 and Yavin Prime visible in the background.|Lepira flew at the Battle of Yavin.]]
Once the Alliance began its initial attack on the Death Star, Vander split Gold Squadron, ordering pilots [[Dex Tiree]] and [[Davish Krail]] to accompany him in heading for the [[battle station]]'s [[meridian trench]] while Lepira and the four other pilots split off from the trio and held back. [[Gazdo Woolcob]] then became the first member of the squadron to be [[Death|killed]],<ref name="Grounded" /> after which Vander commanded Lepira and the other three remaining pilots to engage the Empire's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] as he, Tiree, and Krail entered the trench.<ref name="Sparks" />

Vander and both his wingmen perished in the trench,<ref name="ANH" /> with Lepira and two other members of the squadron also dying<ref name="Death" /> at some point prior to [[Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis]] starting his own trench run.<ref name="French">''[[A New Hope - The Film Novel]]''</ref> Dreis's trench run also failed, but Red Squadron pilot [[Luke Skywalker]] then successfully destroyed the Death Star, leaving [[Lieutenant]] [[Evaan Verlaine]] as the only member of Gold Squadron to survive the battle.<ref name="Grounded" />

==Personality and traits==
Lepira had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
Lepira wore an orange [[flight suit]] with a white [[flak vest]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lepira first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], portrayed by an uncredited actor.<ref name="ANH" /> The Death Star briefing scene was filmed on H Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] between [[May 13]] and [[May 18]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Lepira was identified in ''[[The Odyssey of Star Wars: An Epic Poem]]'', a [[2021]] adaptation of the original trilogy by [[Jack Mitchell]].<ref name="Odyssey" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1998]] ''[[Special Edition Limited]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Lepira}}</ref>
